patches.name: Force ARCore availability: SUPPORTED_INSTALLED (CardboardXR)
patches.description: Experimental: force the real checkAvailability() in CardboardXR (com.google.ar.core.k) to return SUPPORTED_INSTALLED. Fingerprint VERIFIED from the CardboardXR 1.0.0 dex. Does NOT supply a device profile, so AR session creation may still fail.
